description: The Rasmussen family's home on West 47th Avenue in Kerrisdale — designed by Søren for his own family, and the childhood home of his sons Collin and Lucas.
One of three houses Søren made for his family, alongside the Collingwood Residence and the Bowen Island residence.
note: The original site's Kerrisdale Residence gallery was not archived; photographs to come from the family archive.
